draft.title: Society and culture
card: a group of people who share a territory and institutions, such as schools, courts and the family.
the shared values, beliefs, customs and ways of life that a group passes on to new members.
Values are ideas about what matters. Customs are usual ways of acting, such as how a group marks a birthday or a wedding.
The two ideas are linked but not the same. A society is the people and their institutions. Culture is the shared ways of thinking and living within it.
draft.remember: Society is the group of people. Culture is what they share and pass on.

a.q: Which of these describes culture rather than society?
opts: The customs a community passes on to its children
The people who live within the borders of a state
The courts and schools found in a particular region
The group of people living together in a town
a.why: Customs that are shared and passed on to the young are part of culture. The other options describe people, territory or institutions, which are features of a society. The option about courts and schools is tempting, but institutions belong to society.
a.clue: Culture is about what is shared and passed on.

b.q: Mei's family moved to a new town in Victoria. She says, 'Everyone here shares the same council, schools and hospital, and most families gather for the same local festival each year.' Which part of her statement describes culture?
opts: Families gathering for the same local festival each year
Everyone using the same council in the town
Children attending the same schools in the town
Residents using the same hospital in the area
b.why: A festival that families share each year is a custom, which is part of culture. The council, schools and hospital are institutions, which belong to the idea of society. The institutions are tempting because they are shared, but shared institutions define a society, not its culture.
b.clue: Three of these are institutions. Which one is a custom?

a.best: The customs a community passes on to its children

b.best: Families gathering for the same local festival each year

problems.detail: The clue 'Culture is about what is shared and passed on' echoes the right option, the only one that says 'passes on'. A student can match the words without understanding the difference between society and culture.
